physics.where_iam_law: the derived hold (thermal loss from M through two coins per restore) is the floor; the eraser adds a measured share on top; this measures that share in LSK progenitors so the per-type baseline (register A8) has its input
physics.counterparts: chips: a scheduled refresh that rewrites good cells (planned maintenance as a load); qubits: none yet

data.set: GSE72630 (Rao laboratory, La Jolla): WGBS of LSK, 3 wild type, 3 TET2/TET3 double knockout, mm10 (erase_types3_samples.csv)
data.protocol_read: DNA sheared (Covaris S2), Illumina TruSeq Nano DNA libraries, paired 2 x 100 on Genome Analyzer IIx; about 100 million pairs per library in 9 runs
data.spent_first: no: the spent closest data (PHY-085 LSK, TET2 alone, another laboratory) is the rehearsal; only this set has TET2+TET3 in LSK from P4/P5's laboratory

form.form: raw reads from SRA, 10 million pairs in 2,000 blocks over all 9 runs (erase_test.yml, the one command)

data.alternatives: per-site calls carry no molecules, so no lone-loss count; the same laboratory's other sets were P4 and P5
data.needs: paired directional reads, whole-genome spread (2,000 blocks over all runs), mm10, the genotype label per library

preflight.checked: GEO protocol and SRA layout of all six libraries; the block plan of one wild type and one knockout
preflight.result: standard sheared TruSeq libraries; paired; 54 runs; 10,000,000 pairs in 2,000 blocks across all 9 runs of each library

kiss.smallest: the six libraries of the set (three replicates per arm give the null test)
kiss.samples_why: three per arm: the wild types must agree before the ratio is read

machines.github_free_at_design: about 10 of 20 free at 8:00 PM Pacific

save.resume: each library is its own run; a failed run is re-sent alone

instrument_check._from: P5 canary: 1.3 % quality-failed, 98.6 % mapped, 0.00076 s per pair

cosmologist.method: a ratio inside one experiment, so the laboratory's meter cancels; self-check on its own replicates
cosmologist.null_test: the three wild types agree, max |ln ratio| <= 0.05, else not assessed

value.question: the eraser's share in LSK progenitors, and whether three types from one laboratory spread less with their erasers than without (P8)
value.adequate: expected effect about 14 % against replicate spread about 2 %

options.name: the six GSE72630 libraries on GitHub
the cosmologist's way: the same within-experiment ratio, read on its own replicates

value.why_this: free and faster; the ratio inside one experiment is the cosmologist's self-calibration

explore.done: PHY-085 (LSK, TET2 alone, 0.900), P4 (mature B, 1.042), P5 (iNKT, 0.926), the governor checks (inconclusive across laboratories)

prediction.form: knockout over wild type = 1 - s_LSK with s_LSK between TET2's share (0.10) and all three erasers in stem cells (0.136): center 0.86, sigma 0.035

decided_by.s_LSK: TET2's share in LSK measured independently (PHY-085, 0.900, another laboratory) and the stem-cell share (DEV-ERASE-01, 0.864)

prediction.reading: lone-loss held error of each library (the one command, --dev-count-only), each arm's mean

bars.rule: pull = (ratio - 0.86) / 0.035: within 2 passes, 2 to 3 watch, beyond 3 a real miss (WHY_IAM.md rule 4)
